start.description:
The start {$link IstanbulCoverageCoordinate} for a statement, function, or branch used by Istanbul code coverage
tool.

end.description:
The end {$link IstanbulCoverageCoordinate} for a statement, function, or branch used by Istanbul code coverage
tool.

skip.description: Optional parameter used to denote that the location is to be skipped by Istanbul code coverage tool.

title:
IstanbulCoverageLocation persists a starting and ending {$link IstanbulCoverageCoordinate} (line and column number)
used in code used in {@link IstanbulCoverageFileResult}.
name: IstanbulCoverageLocation
